name: BLS E-Services Limited
summary: BLS E-Services Limited is a digital solutions company in India that uses technology to deliver e-services and e-governance. Through a broad network of physical access points, it helps governments and businesses provide public utility, social welfare, health, finance, education, farming and banking services to people in cities, towns, villages and remote areas. Established in Gurugram in 2016, it is owned by BLS International Services Limited.
